title: Methanol Dilution for LCMS Analysis
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it on your computer if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the labware definition files (with .json extensions) to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file (with a .py extension).

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck of the robot to match the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the pipette as described in the app’s calibration workflow (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the methanol dilution protocol for LC‑MS analysis.
